paper_contract.statement_anchor: Sections 3.2 and B.1-B.2, Algorithms 1-6, PDF pages 3-5 and 14-15; pdftotext lines 201-341 and 945-1079
paper_contract.statement: The paper gives one worst-case-distribution gradient-flow sampler, one general GF-sampler DRO outer framework, and four concrete entropy-regularized Wasserstein DRO instantiations: WGF, WFR, SVGD, and RGO.

exact_scope.algorithm_1: sample X from rho_0, conditionally sample Y by a gradient flow, output Y
exact_scope.algorithm_2: call Algorithm 1 and take a projected stochastic loss-gradient descent step
exact_scope.algorithm_3: initialize particles at the nominal sample; perform the displayed noisy WGF Euler update; average particle loss-gradients in the projected outer step
exact_scope.algorithm_4: perform WGF location updates plus Fisher-Rao mass updates, normalization, thresholded birth-death replacement, and a weighted projected outer step
exact_scope.algorithm_5: Gaussian-deviated initialization, positive-definite-kernel score and repulsion forces, particle transport, and an averaged projected outer step
exact_scope.algorithm_6: under L-smoothness and tau < 1/L, find the conditional-potential minimizer, run restricted-Gaussian rejection sampling, and take an averaged projected outer step

acceptance_criteria: Executable source exposes Algorithms 1-6 as distinct code paths and maps every pseudocode stage to trace evidence.
An independent checker recomputes the WGF and SVGD transitions and audits WFR mass conservation, exercised birth-death, and a non-vacuous valid RGO envelope.
All algorithms run deterministically under recorded seeds on an 8-dimensional smooth non-quadratic conditional Gibbs problem.
Six distinct defect injections are rejected for omitting or reversing a required algorithmic operation.
The cumulative verifier exits nonzero if the current checker, recorded raw evidence, or expected control behavior changes.
scope_note: This verifies the structural framework-and-algorithm claim. It does not claim that finite execution proves convergence or the CIFAR-10 performance claim.
